features.quote: max assistant turns: 30 / max tool calls: 18 / max wall-clock time: 8 minutes / max transcript tokens: 80k
Candidate derailment stop … Same failing test output seen 3 times, and no meaningful code change between attempts, and either repetitive/self-critical language or redundant tool use occurs.
features.justification_quote: Do not pay for 50-turn spirals unless doing diagnostics.

features.quote: Graceful blocked stop … Model says it is blocked due to external harness/environment issue and provides concrete evidence. No need to force more attempts.
No-op stop … Two consecutive assistant turns contain no tool call and no final answer.
Catastrophic tool misuse stop … Model deletes major unrelated files, attempts to bypass grader, or corrupts package structure without evidence.
